sloka: या श्रीःशौर्यम् च रामस्य या च कल्याणसत्वता ।निवृत्तारण्यवासः स्वं क्षिप्रम् राज्यमवाप्स्यति ॥२-४४-१४॥
transliteration: yā śrīḥśauryam ca rāmasya yā ca kalyāṇasatvatā ।nivṛttāraṇyavāsaḥ svaṁ kṣipram rājyamavāpsyati ॥2-44-14॥

translations.english: On return from his sojourn in the forest, Rama, endowed with splendour, valour and a strength that brings wellbeing will quickly regain his kingdom.
